description: This file defines the ValidationUniqueAPI class, a REST API endpoint for validating the uniqueness of certain entity attribute values within the OrangeHRM system. It includes configuration for API parameters, validation rules, and interaction with the ValidationUniqueDao for database checks.

classes.name: ValidationUniqueAPI
classes.description: Defines a REST API endpoint for validating the uniqueness of entity attribute values, managing various validation parameters, and interacting with data access objects to determine uniqueness.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to validate whether a given value for a specified entity and attribute is unique, returning the result as JSON.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the parameters of the getOne method, ensuring correct length, presence, and enumeration constraints.

methods.name: getAttributeNameRuleArray
methods.description: Returns the list of valid attribute names for the specified entity based on predefined validation entities.

methods.name: getMatchByFieldRuleArray
methods.description: Returns the list of valid matchByField options for the specified entity.

methods.name: getValidationUniqueDao
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of ValidationUniqueDao for database interactions.
